text: {"name":"cfm_wifi_disable_action","confidence":"medium","docstring":"When the CFM one-shot flag is clear and the state byte exceeds 1, it builds and processes a 20-byte Wi-Fi-disable PDU from the context record and sets the flag; when no record is present, it may instead issue the configured MMIO interrupt-disable write.","subsystem":"cfm","var_renames":{"v1":"action_record","v2":"action_context","v3":"cfm_state","v4":"timing_entry_index","v5":"pdu_buffer","v8":"timing_table"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":72,"meaning":"Pointer to the action record used to populate the outbound PDU."},{"offset":116,"meaning":"Index used to select a timing entry from a table with a 696-byte stride."},{"offset":88,"meaning":"CFM state flag byte; bit 0x20 marks the action as sent."},{"offset":90,"meaning":"CFM state byte that gates PDU generation when greater than 1."}]}
